identity: An Arabic Wikipedia encyclopedia article on بئر التهوية / بئر الهواء (the air well, a dew and water-vapour condenser). Modern Standard Arabic, expository third-person register, evidently translated from an English Wikipedia source: a lead definition paragraph, an unlabelled three-item bulleted list of design approaches, then sectioned body text under the headings مقدمة and تاريخ and the sub-heading مجمع زيبولد. Dense in unit conversions (a metric figure followed by an imperial gloss that was parenthesised before punctuation was stripped) and in European proper names in transliteration. 761 tokens, 13 <NL> tokens, 3 of which bracket one-or-two-token headings.
law: The sentence unit is the orthographic sentence that carried a full stop: one independent predication, verbal or nominal, that could stand alone. A boundary is set where a new predication begins with no syntactic dependency on what precedes — verb-initial clauses (يعتمد، يتضمن، يختلف، تنخفض، أحيط، استخدم، سمح، بدأ، حدثت، اكتشف، بلغت، اتصلت، استخلص، ألهمت، سميت), sentence-initial adverbials and discourse markers (وفقا، حاليا، في الواقع، على الرغم من ذلك، لعل، فعلى سبيل المثال، عندما), negative particles (لا يجب، لم يعلن), and كان or bare-nominal openers. A boundary is NOT set at a coordinating و whose clause continues the same subject or the same event (وقد، وبلغ، ويبلغ، وتم، وحسب، وبعرض، ولا توجد), nor at relative والتي، nor at appositive وهي / وهو ما، nor at the subordinators حيث، عندما، إذا، لكن، إلا، قبل أن، ليصل، بأن. A و IS a boundary when it fronts an adjunct ahead of a fresh main verb (ولتحقيق فرضيته شيد، وعلى الرغم من أن … اعتبرت) and the clause before it is already complete. Parenthetical unit conversions and percentage breakdowns stay inside their sentence and numeric runs are never split. Headings are their own units, forced by the <NL> rule. A bulleted list item is a single sentence: its leading label is a bare noun phrase with no predicate, so it cannot be cut off from the predicate that follows.
reasoning: The decisive test at every و and every fronted concessive was whether the material BEFORE it is already a complete predication. At i=17 (الهواء) the lead definition بئر التهوية … هو بناء أو جهاز يستخدم لجمع الماء بتكثيف بخار الماء الموجود في الهواء is complete, so the following ورغم تعدد تصاميم آبار الهواء opens a new sentence: cut. At i=100 (الرطوبة) the visually identical ورغم فعالية التصميم is NOT a cut, because what precedes it — المجمعات النشطة والتي تعمل بنفس طريقة مزيل الرطوبة — is a bare NP plus relative clause with no predicate; cutting there would strand a fragment. That same fragment test kills a break at i=60 (كبيرة) in the first list item, where آبار هوائية بمنهج كتلة كبيرة is the label and وقد استخدمت is its predicate, and likewise at i=85 in the second item. So all three bulleted design items are single sentences — except the third, which genuinely runs on: at i=117 (خاصة) the clause إلا في حالات خاصة is closed and حاليا ما تزال المحاولات قائمة is a fixed sentence-opening idiom, so I cut. Reading حاليا backwards (except in special cases currently) is grammatically possible but idiomatically bad. At i=36 (خارجي), من الممكن كذلك ألا تحتوي على أية أجزاء متحركة is a fresh impersonal predicate and كذلك marks it as an added statement rather than a continuation. Lexical repetition across a boundary proved a reliable tell and confirmed two cuts outright: ليتكون الندى | الندى هو حالة طبيعية at i=156, and وبركة الندى | بركة الندى هي بركة صناعية at i=331. i=339 (الماشية) is my least certain cut and I marked it med: سميت بهذا الاسم could be read as an asyndetic adjectival clause on the indefinite بركة صناعية, which would make it a comma. I cut anyway because سميت بهذا الاسم refers back to the TERM بركة الندى and not to بركة صناعية, so it must attach to the sentence subject, which forces a new predication. At i=323 the bare numeral 50 closes the relative-humidity example and لا يجب الخلط opens both a new sentence and a new topic. Two sites I deliberately did NOT cut. i=641 (بوصة) leaves a 32-token sentence, my longest: قام بتكديسهم معا modifies the indefinite أحجار بحرية asyndetically and the whole chain describes one construction act; this passage packs measurements densely elsewhere too (23 tokens at 609-631), so the length is in register. i=438 (الأوراق) is the omission I doubt most: تستطيع النباتات امتصاص الندى مباشرة من الأوراق is complete and والفائدة الرئيسية introduces a new subject, which by my own و-rule would argue for a break, but the two clauses jointly explain the immediately preceding claim that the mulch effect is not significant, so I read them as one coordinated explanation. Conversely i=585 (يوم) and i=738 (المكتشفة) are و-sites I did cut, because each fronts an adjunct (ولتحقيق فرضيته، وعلى الرغم من أن) ahead of a fresh main verb (شيد، اعتبرت) after an already-complete sentence; I marked 738 med because its preceding sentence is short and thematically adjacent, so a comma is live there. The narrative spine of the مجمع زيبولد section is a chain of verb-initial past-tense clauses and each of those is taken as a sentence start, while و+verb keeping the same referent (وبلغ طولها، ويبلغ قطرها، وتم تنظيفه، وحسب) is kept inside. Numeric runs are never split: 12 900 كم 3 3 000 ميل مكعب، 9 700 قدم 2، 55 400 لترا، 5 5 بوصة and 3 9 بوصة are single measurements whose internal separators were stripped with the punctuation. Result: 48 units, mean ~15 tokens, no segment lacking a predicate except the three headings, which the <NL> rule forces.
